title: Unsolved Crime
prompt: When Liz was about to find out who killed Mario, she fell asleep. When she woke up she realized she could no longer find out.
solution: Liz was reading a novel on the beach. The main character, Mario, had been killed and she was about to learn who the murderer was. Before she found out, she fell asleep with the book lying in the sand. When she woke up, the tide had risen and washed the book away.
